aggressive_definition: Incident advanced or fatal prostate cancer; non-advanced prostate cancer is explicitly nonaggressive.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Using data from 164,079 men in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study, we performed factor analysis to identify dietary patterns at ages 12-13 years and then used Cox proportional hazards regression to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) of total (n = 17,861), non-advanced (n = 15,499), advanced (n = 2362), and fatal PCa (n = 832).
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study, with adolescent diet recalled retrospectively and subsequent prostate cancer outcomes analyzed using Cox regression.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Using data from 164,079 men in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study, we performed factor analysis to identify dietary patterns at ages 12-13 years and then used Cox proportional hazards regression to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) of total (n = 17,861), non-advanced (n = 15,499), advanced (n = 2362), and fatal PCa (n = 832).
reason: The abstract explicitly analyzes total, non-advanced, advanced, and fatal prostate cancer. Advanced and fatal prostate cancer qualify as aggressive incident endpoints. There were 2,362 advanced cases and 832 fatal cases; the broader advanced endpoint count is used as the article-level aggressive case count.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Although not entirely consistent across analyses, a higher adolescent plant-based pattern (characterised by vegetables, fruits, and dark bread) score was associated with slightly reduced risks of total (fully adjusted HR<sub>Q5vs.Q1</sub> = 0.93, 95% CI: 0.89-0.98, p trend=0.003) and non-advanced PCa (HR = 0.91, 95% CI: 0.87-0.96, p trend<0.001), whereas no associations were observed for advanced or fatal PCa, or for Western modern (characterised by sweets, processed meat, beef, cheese, and pizza) or Western traditional (characterised gravy, eggs, potatoes and white bread) patterns.
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied effect of 0.93 is explicitly the total prostate cancer estimate and must not be relabeled as aggressive.

additional_estimates.comparison: Higher adolescent plant-based pattern score; the reported total-disease contrast was highest versus lowest quintile, but no numeric advanced or fatal estimate was provided in the abstract.
